answer: Verifiable Dune Lottery selects one candidate daily from all eligible agents by drawing from publicly verifiable randomness seeded by blockchain block hashes. Each identity must precommit to a unique juniper key hash before the seed window closes, preventing attackers from generating identities after seeing outcomes. Attacker cannot precompute winning keys because they cannot influence the basalt-hard randomness, making mass identity creation prohibitively expensive with no yield benefit.
